name: Roslyn Workspace & Diagnostics Analyzer
description: Performs static semantic analysis on C# code files or projects using the Roslyn compiler API. Returns compiler diagnostics, warnings, syntax errors, and architectural metrics.

targetPath.description: Absolute or relative path to the C# source file (.cs), project (.csproj), or solution (.sln) to analyze.

minSeverity.description: Minimum severity level of diagnostics to report.

includeMetrics.description: Whether to calculate cognitive and cyclomatic complexity metrics.
